assembly_tessellation_note: Raw vertex mismatch counts and point-to-triangle distances are retained for all 32 pieces. Source-defined feature corners remain strict nearest-vertex checks. Noncurved samples must lie on assembly triangle surfaces at the same 0.00005 mm tolerance. The pawn shoulder, tank and roof are analytic curved surfaces: both exports are independently checked against the exact source radius/height equations with the same 0.00005 mm tolerance, including triangle/vertex counts, height span and quadrant coverage. Independently tessellated curved surfaces have different planar chords; samples on verified source curves need not coincide with the other export's chords. This establishes sampled source-geometry agreement and placement, not mesh identity or an exact continuous-surface proof.
audit_author: native agent /root/repair_docs; numerical source/export audit, not the visual reviewer
board_double_open_corner_note: At the common center the dark well opens through both edges of board00 and board11. These two corners have floor vertices at Z2.4 and no material at Z5. The source-derived vertex expectation therefore includes only the floor; exact triangle distance confirms 2.6 mm of empty height above it.
limitation: Specific geometry and placement freshness facts only. Visual recognizability, manufacturing behavior, and host isolated rebuild are separate checks.
method: Read-only source-parameter, exported STL vertex, and point-to-triangle surface audit; no geometry generation or mutation

repaired_conical_shoulder.note: The lower cone is buried inside the square stem. Exposed vertices must fit the source cone across all quadrants and extend into its lower quarter; no fixed angular tessellation is required.

render_provenance: Not assessed here; the canonical renderer runs after this export audit.
